model_meta.system_name: Toroidal continuously variable transmission with wire-synchronized roller supports
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of a toroidal CVT emphasizing its discs, power rollers and supporting members, three-wire gyration synchronization, axial pressing input, and guide-wall routing of the third wire.

subsystems.description: Two input discs are coaxially connected to the input shaft; two output discs are coaxially disposed between the input discs. The claim set identifies the disc arrangement but this model does not assert unclaimed detailed torque interfaces.

parts.description: Input shaft coaxially connected to first and second input discs.
First and second coaxial input discs.
First and second output discs coaxially disposed between the input discs.

subsystems.description: Four power rollers are positioned as two pairs between respective input/output disc pairs; each roller is supported by a corresponding power-roller supporting member.

parts.description: Power rollers, two between each corresponding input/output disc pair.
Power-roller supporting members supporting respective rollers.

subsystems.description: First and second wires are each wound in an 8-figure around a paired set of supporting members; a third wire is wound around all four supporting members and fixed to a diagonal pair. Together the wires synchronize roller gyration angles.

parts.description: First, second, and third synchronization wires with the claimed routing.

subsystems.description: Guide walls located between paired supporting members bend the third wire toward the output discs; the bend increases winding angle at the diagonally fixed supports. Claim 2 further describes each wall offset from the centered position so the third-wire winding angle increases at the fixed diagonal second and third supports and decreases at the other diagonal first and fourth supports, compared with centered walls. Claim 3 states that winding angle at each of the second and third supports exceeds the sum of support-member swing angle and the angle occupied by a fixing member. Claim 9 places the walls on the output-disc side of lines joining paired support-member outer peripheries.
Pressure means applies pressing force axially to the pair of input discs. The claims do not identify a specific implementation.

item_flows.name: Axial pressing force
item_flows.notes: Pressure means applies the force along the CVT axial direction to the pair of input discs (claim 1).

item_flows.name: Mechanical coupling through synchronization wires
item_flows.notes: Qualitative abstraction of wire-mediated coupling/synchronization of power-roller supporting-member gyration angles; the patent describes the wires' routing and synchronization effect, not a quantified rotational flow, torque, power, or measured motion-transfer specification. The third wire is routed over guide walls.

actions.name: Guide third wire toward output discs

steps.description: Contact the third wire between paired supporting members.
Bend the third wire toward the output discs, increasing its winding angle at the diagonally fixed supporting members.
First and second 8-figure wires couple the supporting members of each roller pair.
Third wire couples all four supporting members and is fixed to a diagonally arranged pair.
The three wires synchronize the gyration angles of the four power rollers.
